subject: english
prompt: Why should an English learner consider the audience before writing?

options.text: Word choice and tone can be adjusted for the reader and purpose.
Every reader expects exactly the same message.

answer.explanation: Audience and purpose guide suitable vocabulary, tone, and detail.
